text:
alex: Ran a focused harness today comparing kernel selection strategies across same-model configs. baseline (v1 kernels) vs new selector (v2) + batching tweaks.

alex: Nightly CI produced a 7.8% median latency win on short seqs, but noticed a 12% p99 regression for 2x batch sizes.

alex: Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.local/runs/1769456789 (public to eng) :eyes:

maria: nice. can you paste the exact harness command you ran?

alex: sure —
```bash
./harness/run_comparison.sh --model llama-7b --kernels v1,v2 --seqs 32,128 --batch 1,2,4 --replays 1000 --collect kv_warmup,latency,hist
```

cheng: saw the output. kv cache warmup looks suspicious for v2 at batch 2 — warmup hits are lower, so more cold misses at earlier tokens.

alex: good catch. sample trace:
```
[trace] request=37 token=4 kv_miss=true time_ms=1.8
[trace] request=37 token=5 kv_miss=true time_ms=2.1
```

benchbot: Automated summary: baseline median=18.2ms, v2 median=16.8ms (-7.8%), baseline p99=210ms, v2 p99=235ms (+12%). see /bench/1769456789/summary

ci-bot: ALERT: nightly-perf/regression threshold breached for p99 latency on eng-runtime (job=kernel-harness). Failing status sent to #eng-oncall.

sam: probably the selector picks a faster kernel that doesn't handle KV streaming as well under batching. could add a heuristic: prefer kernel with KV_hit_rate>0.9 for batch>1.

rachel: small repro: disable continuous batching in v2 and p99 goes back in line. suspect off-by-one in batching window that moves cache offsets.

maria: can we add a synthetic replay with cached prefixes to CI so we exercise warm paths? current replays start from cold ON every iteration.

alex: yes — plan: add a reproducer job `harness/cached_prefix_replay` that runs at 2am, compare selector metrics and add percentile-based alerts (p50/p95/p99) with rolling-window smoothing.

sam: also triage flaky runs: add a "stability" metric = stdev(p99 across last 5 runs) and mute alerts until stdev<10%.

rachel: created an issue: https://tracker.redwood.local/ISSUE-4827 — includes trace, logs, and a small patch idea.

alex: thanks all. I'll push a small change to the selector to bias toward KV-friendly kernels and schedule the cached-prefix job. tagging @cheng for validation.

cheng: will validate tomorrow morning, adding a profiler capture (perf + nvprof) to the harness for deeper kernel hotpath timing.

benchbot: Job queued: cached_prefix_replay at 02:00 UTC. Link: /jobs/1769460001

ci-bot: noted. leaving this thread open for triage notes. :white_check_mark:
